content_units: 45-Minute Beginner Run Playlist
A smooth BPM build for an easy run: gentle warm-up, steady mid-run energy, then a relaxed cool-down. All picks are clean-leaning mainstream pop/hip-hop from 2005–2022 with varied artists.

To match your BPM targets more closely, here is the tightened version I recommend using:

Running Flow Notes
-   Warm-up:   easy walk-to-jog transition, relaxed cadence.
-   Steady run:   consistent effort without pushing a beginner pace too hard.
-   Cool-down:   bring heart rate down gradually while keeping the mood upbeat.

Track Selection Notes

A few popular songs often get tagged with slightly different BPM values across catalogs and DJ databases, so exact BPM can vary by source by a few beats. The recommended set above is arranged for the intended feel and progression first, with clean-leaning, beginner-friendly energy.
